Condition : 3 - The lighting strip shall not be lit between the hours of 11pm and 7pm.

Condition : 4 - Illumination for the proposed lighting must be below the limit set out in the Institute of Lighting Engineer's (ILE) technical note no. 5 "The Brightness of illuminated advertisement'.
Condition : 5 - The proposed lighting must not have any intermittent light source, or exposed cold cathode tubing.
